note: Common Paper publishes no cover page for the AI Addendum. These fields are the substitution points its Standard Terms already name; the labels and hints are ours.

sections.title: Model training
sections.hint: Leave Training Data and Training Purposes empty and the Standard Terms forbid training outright.

fields.label: Training data
fields.hint: Which of the customer's inputs or outputs, if any, may be used to train a model.
fields.placeholder: Prompts submitted through the public API, excluding any file attachments

fields.label: Training purposes
fields.hint: What that training data may be used to do. Required if training is permitted at all.
fields.placeholder: Improving the accuracy of the provider's own classification models

fields.label: Training restrictions
fields.hint: Limits on that training — retention, de-identification, anything off-limits.
fields.placeholder: Data must be de-identified before use and deleted within 12 months

fields.label: Improvement restrictions
fields.hint: Limits on using inputs and outputs to run and improve the service short of training.
fields.placeholder: No human review of customer inputs without prior written consent
